title: Dev Readiness Validation and Handover
definitionOfDevReady: A developer or AI agent can clone the repository, set it up from documented steps, run the local and composed foundation, execute proof and validation commands, understand failures, make a governed change, and submit a compliant PR without private knowledge, hidden local state, real secrets, or real tenant data.

handoverPath.ciExpectation: Pull requests run validate-spec; main pushes run proof-anchor. Local make verify remains the required dev-readiness handover superset before PR ready state and before Linear Done.

branchPreMergeValidation.purpose: Validate PR branch changes before ready or merge. This evidence is not used as a substitute for post-merge validation.

freshCloneValidation.purpose: Prove the documented clone and make verify path from a clean checkout before merge.

finalPostMergeValidation.purpose: Prove the final merged dev-readiness evidence after PR #194 on main, distinct from branch and fresh-clone validation.
finalPostMergeValidation.nonClaimBoundary: This post-merge validation supports bounded dev-readiness handover evidence only and does not claim test, staging, production, deployment, live-provider, SOC, ISO certification, enterprise production, product UI, browser E2E, full product readiness, or broader readiness.

failuresFixedDuringUSF226.failure: Transitive protobufjs 7.5.8 advisory through Temporal packages
failuresFixedDuringUSF226.fix: Added exact pnpm workspace override pinning protobufjs to 7.6.4
failuresFixedDuringUSF226.result: corepack pnpm audit --audit-level low reports no known vulnerabilities

failuresFixedDuringUSF226.fix: Updated @keycloak/keycloak-admin-client to exact patched version 26.5.6 and aligned adapter, runtime manifest, enterprise evidence, and validator expectations
failuresFixedDuringUSF226.result: corepack pnpm audit --audit-level low reports no known vulnerabilities

failuresFixedDuringUSF226.failure: USF-RUNTIME-016 initially expected the old Keycloak client exact version after the audit fix
failuresFixedDuringUSF226.fix: Updated runtime validator and evidence metadata to require @keycloak/keycloak-admin-client 26.5.6

failuresFixedDuringUSF226.failure: Fresh-clone trial failed before repository validation because the host disallowed creating a global pnpm shim under /usr/bin
failuresFixedDuringUSF226.fix: Removed corepack enable from the required fresh-clone handover path because make verify invokes corepack pnpm directly
failuresFixedDuringUSF226.result: Fresh-clone make verify passed from /tmp/usf-226-fresh-clone.UH4ysa without requiring corepack enable

failuresFixedDuringUSF226.failure: Fresh-clone make verify exposed a Windmill SDK readiness timeout when Docker selected Fetch-forbidden loopback port 1720
failuresFixedDuringUSF226.fix: Compose proof harnesses now preselect and assert Fetch-safe ephemeral loopback ports instead of accepting Docker's unrestricted random host port; Windmill records safeLoopbackPortChecked evidence and runtime validation enforces the marker
failuresFixedDuringUSF226.result: Targeted ClickHouse, Redis, ClamAV, SonarQube, WireMock, LocalStack, mock-substrate, and Windmill proofs passed after the safe-port fix; fresh-clone make verify then passed
